name: Positional Encoding Frequency Annealing
aliases: Positional Encoding with Coarse-to-Fine Frequency Activation
definition: A coarse-to-fine strategy that constrains Fourier positional encoding to low dimensions initially to suppress high-frequency artifacts and self-occlusions.
summary: Positional Encoding Frequency Annealing is a coarse-to-fine optimization strategy that dynamically controls Fourier encoding bandwidth to suppress high-frequency artifacts and prevent overfitting.
